content: Support for unsupported SAE J1939 DM-messages Description: All DM-messages that are not listed in [RS_Diag_04113] shall be supported by a generic service. Rationale: An application shall be capable of handling DM-messages that are not directly handled by the implementation of the diagnostics module. Use Case: Handling of memory access or routine control. AppliesTo: CP Dependencies: [RS_Diag_04113] Supporting Material: SAE J1939-73+
